texts.label: text
texts.orig: We use a simple contrastive learning framework to pre-train models for information retrieval. Contriever, trained without supervision, is competitive with BM25 for R@100 on the BEIR benchmark. After finetuning on MSMARCO, Contriever obtains strong performance, especially for the recall at 100.
texts.text: We use a simple contrastive learning framework to pre-train models for information retrieval. Contriever, trained without supervision, is competitive with BM25 for R@100 on the BEIR benchmark. After finetuning on MSMARCO, Contriever obtains strong performance, especially for the recall at 100.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: We also trained a multilingual version of Contriever, mContriever, achieving strong multilingual and cross-lingual retrieval performance.
texts.text: We also trained a multilingual version of Contriever, mContriever, achieving strong multilingual and cross-lingual retrieval performance.
